projects.title: Rydberg electric-field calibration
projects.summary: Two atomic readouts share a square-root RF-power law, with separate calibrations and held-out error checks.
projects.editorial_review: Retained for a compact physical scaling form, two readout channels, and greater than 92% reduction in held-out RMSE versus a development-mean baseline. Only two held-out power settings per channel; the channels share one RF chain.

projects.editorial_review: Retained at the project owner’s request. The promoted relationship reconstructs a force-plate torque under its recorded coordinate convention. It is an instrument consistency rule, not a new biological mechanism.

projects.title: ATLAS transverse momentum
projects.summary: Missing-momentum components reproduce the measured magnitude and direction across six ATLAS run periods.
projects.editorial_review: Retained as a parameter-free geometric consistency example. Two held-out files contain 78,227 events with magnitude errors near numerical precision. This recovers a known vector identity and validates representation consistency; it is not a new particle-physics law or an independent detector calibration.

projects.title: Earthquake magnitude scaling
projects.summary: A one-parameter exponential law describes the fraction of catalog earthquakes above each magnitude threshold.
projects.editorial_review: Retained for a compact distribution law with 18 development, 6 validation, and 7 held-out days. Test normalized RMSE 0.1267 versus 0.6584 for the frozen linear baseline. Restricted to the ml scale and qualifying days above the query cutoff; no event-time or location prediction.
